snippet.title: DEADBUS Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now and play the DEMO!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4132250/DEADBUS/

DEADBUS is a first-person shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by the dead.

You’re part of a special unit sent into infected zones to clear out the area and rescue any survivors left behind.

Work fast. Stay sharp. Hit your numbers. If you fall behind, you’re just another body in the pile.

Each mission has a quota. How efficiently you kill determines your score. Ammo is limited, so every bullet matters. You can find supplies scattered throughout the level, but don’t expect it to be enough.

The DEADBUS won’t wait forever. Every operation runs on a timer, and when it’s over, the bus leaves whether you’re on it or not.
